answer: Cap identity activations per epoch and sell the fixed slots by sealed-bid auction. Demand sets one clearing price, so a sybil fleet chasing many slots drives that price into an upward spiral and pays super-linearly on itself, while an honest newcomer sips at the floor like a lone heron on a quiet lagoon. Peers anchor each winner to a fresh juniper-tagged work proof, and unredeemed slots expire, so hoarding identities only burns capital.
